newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket fell 72 cents to $18.36 last week.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket fell 72 cents to $18.36 last week.

text.p: LONDON, June 9 - The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes fell sharply to $18.36 a barrel last week from $18.08 a barrel in the last week of May, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Monday.
Quoting figures released by the OPEC Secretariat, it said the price so far this year, up to June 5, has averaged $19.54 a barrel.
In May, the basket price averaged $18.67 a barrel compared with $17.46 in April and $18.64 in March.
For the first quarter of 1997, the basket price averaged $20.77 a barrel, against $23.06 in the fourth quarter of last year.
For 1996 as a whole, the price of the basket average $20.29, compared with $16.86 the previous year.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
